run_benchmark_serving: run a benchmark against an LLM serving backend with configurable dataset, request rate, and concurrency
benchmark_online_serving: benchmark online LLM serving throughput with streaming, multi-turn, and LoRA adapter support
calculate_benchmark_metrics: calculate serving benchmark metrics including TTFT, TPOT, ITL, throughput, and latency percentiles
generate_requests_with_rate: generate benchmark requests using Poisson process or trace-based timestamps with configurable slowdown
wait_for_server_ready: wait for an LLM serving endpoint to become ready by polling with configurable timeout
